claim_summary: The entire rational degree-four homology character of the binary PG(3,2) cap complex for GL4(F2) is the sum of the restrictions to A8 of the S8 Specht modules of shapes (7,1) and (4,3,1), of degrees seven and seventy. Other rational reduced homology vanishes and the full symmetry quotient is rationally acyclic.
integrity: The complete character was calculated by a finite exhaustive signed Lefschetz procedure and checked with independent oriented-face and character-theoretic computations. Independent mathematical review and definitive priority adjudication have not occurred.
limitations: Only the rational homology representation and rational symmetry-quotient homology of the binary PG(3,2) cap simplicial complex are classified. Integral equivariant lattices, integral quotient torsion, equivariant homotopy types, and other dimensions remain unresolved.
title: The \(A_8\)-Specht character of the binary projective cap complex
